session-reconnect-reconcile.reason: Frozen Go waits for its 30-second refresh worker after a session_revoke LISTEN gap. The reviewed AUTHRT fix requires Rust to refresh immediately after subscribing, before processing queued notifications.
session-reconnect-reconcile.original_evidence: Original test observed no closure within 5s; periodic refresh closed the session at 30s (AUTHRT-review-imap-reconnect-red.log).
